title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads through a population under social influence, information campaigns, mandates, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use among their social contacts and update adoption probability based on observed norms and tie strength.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Household members influence each other's adoption and share mask inventory.

interactions.name: policy_effect
interactions.description: Mandates and messaging change adoption probabilities and compliance behavior.

interactions.name: enforcement_check
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask policies; noncompliant individuals may face penalties.

interactions.name: purchase_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks from retailers subject to stock, price, subsidies, and rationing.

interactions.name: message_exposure
interactions.description: Individuals receive messages from information sources affecting beliefs and attitudes.

interactions.name: risk_signal_update
interactions.description: Community infection prevalence influences perceived risk and adoption decisions.

interactions.name: norm_observation_in_locations
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask use prevalence in shared locations which affects their subsequent adoption.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals wearing masks at each time step and at the end of the simulation.

metrics.name: adoption_trajectory
metrics.description: Time series of adoption rate showing diffusion dynamics.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days required to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: compliance_rate_in_mandated_locations
metrics.description: Share of individuals compliant with mask policy in locations where it is required.

metrics.name: unmet_demand_ratio
metrics.description: Fraction of attempted purchases that fail due to insufficient retailer stock.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across groups (e.g., by income or risk group), such as a Gini or Theil index.

metrics.name: message_impact
metrics.description: Estimated change in adoption attributable to information campaigns (e.g., difference-in-differences between exposed and unexposed agents).

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of enforcement events (warnings, fines) and associated penalties issued.

metrics.name: average_perceived_risk
metrics.description: Mean perceived risk among individuals over time.
